decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing numbers 522/01/500 Rev P04, 522/02/200 Rev P04, 522/02/201 Rev P04, 522/02/202 Rev P04, 522/02/203 Rev P04, 522/02/208 Rev P04, 522/02/400 Rev P04, 522/02/401 Rev P04, 522/02/402 Rev P04 and 522/02/403 Rev P04, dated 24th April 2025.

The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension(s) hereby permitted shall match those specified in drawing numbers 522/02/200 Rev P04 and 522/02/201 Rev P04 dated 24th April 2025 and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

<p>The flat roof area of the extension(s) hereby approved shall be accessed for the purpose of maintenance only and shall not be used as a terrace/balcony nor access provided over for use as amenity space at any time.</p>
description: Construction of a part single storey, part two storey rear extension, dormer to main rear roof together with two rooflights at front, replacement windows at front and rear elevations, installation of solar panels and air source heat pump (ASHP) in rear garden and waste storage in front garden.
